reason: The cited evidence (E1) discusses magnetic moments and mentions that Mn can be magnetically frustrated in the HEA, but it does not link this frustration to suppression of an fcc-to-hcp phase transformation, nor does it provide evidence that Mn-reduced alloys undergo such a transformation more readily or that this affects mechanical properties. The key mechanistic premises are therefore unsupported by the cited passage.
